metadata.title: On evolution of mean curvature and minimal areas in general codimension for inverse problems
metadata.abstract: Many seemingly standard formulas for the evolution of the mean curvature vector in higher codimension assume only normal variations, which are ill-suited for analyzing the evolution of submanifolds- with-boundary whose boundaries may not be moving orthogonally at each time. Such situations arise when one considers inverse problems for minimal areas, for example, where such boundaries are confined to a larger ambient boundary. In this note, we provide coordinate-free identities for use in such problems, including higher order derivatives of mean curvature. We translate these identities to some of the existing inverse problem literature in codimension one. We also hope readers may find the computational framework helpful in other situations arising in geometric analysis.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 为有边界子流形的变分提供无坐标平均曲率向量演化公式，允许切向分量，并包含更高阶导数。动机是边界被限制在环境边界、未必逐时正交运动的最小面积逆问题；作者把框架与部分既有余维一逆问题文献对应起来。
techniques: 一般变分下平均曲率向量
analysis.breakthrough: 补足仅允许法向变分公式在移动边界逆问题中的适用缺口。
analysis.limitations: 主要交付为恒等式与计算框架，摘要未宣称新的完整逆问题唯一性定理。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第1页虽先否认写作、文献、思想和计算使用AI，但紧接明确例外：单次使用Claude 4.5核验引理3在Y=∂tF特殊情形的陈述，因此仅记verification。不能把否定开头误判完全无使用，亦不能扩大为一般引理证明、完整推导核验或计算用途。第3、11页Astra为as well as Tracey/as well as translate文字拼接。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.11837v1 · PDF 第1页Statement on AI Use，全文13页。
